newsitem.title: USA: CBOT says COM membership sells for record $160,000.
newsitem.headline: CBOT says COM membership sells for record $160,000.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said a Commodity Options Market (COM) membership sold Thursday for a record high $160,000.
The previous record of $157,000 was set February 18 for a COM membership, which allows holders to trade all CBOT options products.
The current bid and offer for a COM seat are $160,000 and $175,000, the CBOT said. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
